card.name: Inside penicillin-class antibiotic names
card.fires_on: Partway through penicillin-type antibiotic names such as methicillin, ampicillin, benzylpenicillin, nafcillin and dicloxacillin, on the pieces just before the final -illin ending. Also fires inside clindamycin.

modes.label: Ending -illin
modes.description: The final piece -illin or -ill of a penicillin-class drug name.

modes.label: Middle of the name
modes.description: The middle piece (ic, ind) before the name finishes, as in ampicillin or clindamycin.

card.plain: It lights up while a penicillin-type antibiotic name is being spelled out, near its end.
